routes.notes: Needs Chat (2048). Body {"instance": URL}. Returns {token, expires_at, aud}: an EdDSA JWT (10 minutes, single use) made for that one instance. Its scp claim lists the instance scopes the Nookara token holds: chat (Chat), voice (Voice), media (Upload Media), sign (Sign Messages). Hand the JWT to POST INSTANCE/api/v1/auth/velora. Errors: invalid_instance, instance_banned, insufficient_scope, scope_disabled.
Retired (410 device_keys_retired). Use GET /bonfire/signing-key.
Public. Returns {kid, user_id, public_key, created_at, revoked_at}, or 404 key_not_found. Instances and clients use it to verify signed messages.
Public. Every key of one account, including revoked ones.

Needs Chat. Returns {default_instance, instances: [{url, position, added_at, muted, push, auto_join}]}: the Ember servers saved on the account. The official server (default_instance) is added once per account; auto_join is true until a client confirms with POST /bonfire/instances/default-joined.
Needs Chat. Body {url?}. The client confirms it joined (or chose not to join) the official server; clears auto_join.
Needs Chat. Replaces the whole list in this order (at most 100 normalized origins). Muted and push settings of kept entries are preserved.
Needs Chat. Body {url, muted?, push?}: per-server push consent for offline mentions. 404 instance_not_in_list.
Instance-only: used by bonfire-server to register itself (single-use nonce). Not for clients.
Instance-only: a bonfire-server proves control of its key and URL here. Not for clients.
Needs Chat. Body {attestation}: the instance owner links payouts (credits from role shops) using GET INSTANCE/api/v1/instance/owner-attestation.
Needs Chat, query url. Who receives shop payments for an instance; only the registered owner can read it.
Needs Sign Messages (32768). Returns {kid, public_key, private_key, created_at} (no-store). One Ed25519 key per account, created on first use. Keep the private key in memory only.
Website session only; an app or project token is refused. Revokes the active key and returns a new {kid, public_key, created_at}. Old messages stay valid.
Information about the signed-in account key without the private half.

Needs Chat. Body {platform, guild_id, channels, roles, options?, instance}. Starts a background job that builds a bonfire-export-v1 zip (channels, roles, emoji; no members or messages) and returns {job_id, ticket, instance, expires_at}. The one-time ticket goes to POST INSTANCE/api/v1/import/velora.
Needs Chat. Job state {status, progress, stage, error, instance, size, expires_at, downloaded}. Owner only.

Public, CORS open. Query q, page. Returns {page, page_size: 24, has_more, results: [{id, url, name, description, icon_url, member_count, invite_url, tags, trusted, updated_at}]}. Treat every field as untrusted text.
Needs Currency Pay (1024) and a CAPTCHA pass. Pays a role-shop request an instance made. Do not auto-approve for the user.
Needs Currency Pay. Only the payer can decline.

Client-specific protocol. The login page trades the one-time code from /login?oauth= for one of three answers: a session ({token, user}); sign-up details ({signup: true, ...}); or, for a linked account with no password, {set_password: true, step, provider_name, username, free_rename_until} and no session. That last answer needs the HttpOnly browser cookie set by /auth/oauth/:p/start. Without it: 403 oauth_wrong_browser {provider_name}, and the sign-in has to be started again in that browser. The code works once either way.

Client-specific protocol. Sets the first password of a linked account with no password, then signs in ({token, user}). Body: step from /auth/oauth/exchange and password (at least 8 characters, else password_too_short, and the step stays usable). Needs the same browser cookie as /auth/oauth/exchange. The step works once and lasts 10 minutes. It never replaces a password: an account that has one by now answers password_already_set. Bans and suspensions answer as they do for any sign-in, and no password is set. Counts against the sign-in rate limit.

Client-specific protocol. Creates an account from sign-up details returned by /auth/oauth/exchange and signs in. password is required (at least 8 characters, else password_too_short); nothing is created without it. username, tos_accepted and birthdate are required too.

Browser entry point of the official apps: ?state=STATE (16 to 128 URL-safe characters) and client=web|desktop|android. Redirects to the Nookara consent screen.
Public. What the official Ember apps ask for: {version, scopes: [{id, bit, required: false, since, name, reason}], permissions_integer, ...}. Nothing is required; every scope is the person's choice.

Any token. Compares the token with what Ember asks for: {granted, effective, disabled, not_granted: [...]}. Informational: not_granted never blocks. Also works as a general "which scopes did I get?" call.
Official apps: body {code, state} returns {token, username, scopes, version}. One try per code.
Official apps: revokes the app token that was replaced after a new sign-in.

Gone (410 login_again). Apps now sign in through the consent screen.

Newest first. Query unread=1 (only unread), category (one category key), cursor (the last id you got, for the next page), limit (up to 50). Returns {notifications: [{id, category, kind, title, body, link, icon, actor: {username, pfp_url} | null, data, read, read_at, created_at}], next_cursor, unread}. title and body are plain text with **bold** as the only markup; render it yourself, never as HTML.
Returns {unread}: the number for the bell.
Body {ids: [..]} or {all: true}. Returns {success, unread}. Your other sockets get notifications_updated.
Body {ids: [..]}. Marks them unread again. Returns {success, unread}.
Deletes one of your notifications. Returns {success, unread}, or 404 not_found.

Returns {categories: [{key, label, description, icon, locked, staff, email, list}]} in settings order. locked categories (system, moderation) are always on. staff categories only exist for staff accounts. list = it lands in the bell and on your devices; email = it is also emailed (throttled).
Body {prefs: {<category>: {email?: bool, list?: bool}}}. Locked and unknown categories are ignored. Returns {success, categories} like the GET.

Who can see a channel, for a member list. Needs access to the channel yourself (404 otherwise). Returns {all: true} when nothing limits who sees it, otherwise {all: false, ids: [user id, ...]} = the server members who can see it (role overwrites, private channels, game console channels; owners, admins and Manage channels always see).

Translates text on Nookara (Ember uses it where the browser has no translator). text up to 3000 characters, to is a language tag like en or pt-BR, from is optional (auto-detected). 40 a minute per account. Returns {text, from, to}.

Ember Beta status. Returns {beta, membership, product}. beta is true only with a live active or trialing membership of the Ember Beta product (selling the product does not count); membership is {status, period, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, test} or null; product is the public product view (or null if it is not on sale). Cached for 30 seconds per account.
Same answer as GET /chat/beta, skipping the 30 second cache (use it right after a purchase or a cancel).
Removes a saved message by its saved id (the id from POST /chat/saved or GET /chat/saved). Always {ok:true}.

Saves a message. kind channel: id is a channel message id. kind dm: id is the DM id, and the token needs Read Instant Messages. kind group: send snapshot {room, room_name, user, message, created_at, id} instead of id (group chats keep no history on the server). At most 500 saved. Returns {ok, id}; saving the same message again returns the same id.
Which of these messages are saved? kind channel, dm or group, ids up to 200 message ids (group: room:id). Returns {saved: {message ref: saved id}}; messages that are not saved are left out.

Ember Inbox, Saved. before is a saved id; limit 1 to 100 (default 50). Returns {saved: [{id, kind, saved_at, message?, with?, missing?, hidden?}], has_more}. kind is channel, dm or group; missing means the original is gone or you lost access; hidden means a saved DM and the token lacks Read Instant Messages. DM messages use the normal /im shape (an encrypted envelope for end-to-end encrypted DMs).

Ember Inbox, Mentions. The last 30 days of messages in your servers that mention you (@name, a reply to you, @everyone or @here, one of your roles), newest first, only channels you can see. before is a message id; limit 1 to 50 (default 30). Returns {messages: [message + channel_name, server_name, server_icon, unread], has_more}.

Bot payments. Authorization: Bot TOKEN only (a user token is refused). Asks a buyer for credits; the money goes to the bot owner. Returns 201 with the request and its pay_url, or 200 with idempotent_replay true when the same order_id, buyer and amount were already created. 60 creates per minute per bot. See Bot payments in the guide.

Bot payments. With order_id returns that single request (404 not_found if none); otherwise lists your latest requests as {requests: [...]}, optionally filtered by status (pending, paid, declined, expired, cancelled) and limit. 300 reads per minute per bot.
Bot payments. One request of your own bot (404 not_found for anything else). Fulfil an order only when status is paid.
Bot payments. Cancels a pending request. 409 payment_in_progress while the buyer is paying, 409 not_cancellable once paid, declined or expired; cancelling a cancelled request is a no-op 200.
